== Summary ==
Marcin Solonczak of Krakow, Poland, Sullust champion, is making his first trip to the Star Wars CCG World Finals. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Marcin Solonczak]].
